svg.title: cohors overview, then a dry run
svg.desc:
$ cohors overview
▜▒▟███▙▒▛ cohors v0.8.20 ▟██▌█▐██▙ 24 repositories. 4 have work at risk, 3 need a look, 17 are clean. ▀▐▖▀█▀▗▌▀ ~/Developer
── Do next ─────────────────────── most urgent first; the command under each step starts it ── WARN Push 1 commit from 1 repository They exist only on this machine: payment-service. cohors push --select 'ahead,!diverged' WARN Reconcile 1 diverged branch Local and remote both moved, so neither a push nor a fast-forward pull will work: mobile-app. cohors scan --select diverged …
$ cohors push --select ahead --dry-run
▜▒▟███▙▒▛ cohors v0.8.20 ▟██▌█▐██▙ push: git push across the repos you pick ▀▐▖▀█▀▗▌▀ never force-pushes, so remote history stays safe
── Dry run ──────────────────────────────────────── would push 2 repos, nothing will change ── › mobile-app ~/Developer/mobile-app › payment-service ~/Developer/payment-service
